strategies.title: Extra Protein Boost
strategies.tip: Swap water for milk or soy milk in oatmeal, or stir in a scoop of unflavored protein powder right after cooking.

strategies.title: Flash-Freeze Grab & Go
strategies.tip: Freeze ripe bananas and berry blends in single-serve bags so you can blend them straight with milk for a fast morning smoothie.

strategies.title: Smart Carb Swaps
strategies.tip: Use rolled oats or quinoa as a base when keeping refined carbs low—they absorb savory flavors easily and keep you full longer.

strategies.title: Flavor & Acid Balancing
